title: Inside a Bike Fitter’s Custom Built Bike - Yoeleo Altera G21 Gravel Bike

takeaways.text: Chosen by a bike fitter for big tire clearance without slack touring geometry: a race-capable position with a long wheelbase that he finds handles very well; responsive and stiff where needed in his first race.
Runs a 55 mm front and 50 mm rear Schwalbe G-One on 28 mm-internal wheels, with 1× 42T; the owner says the frame is rated 2.2 in front and 2.1 in rear.
The round 27.2 mm inline seatpost suits fitting; he mixes Ultegra road shifters with a GRX rear derailleur and SRAM 160 mm cranks, and Yoeleo offers custom colours (his is white and gold).
Bought with his own money (wheels and bar gifted by their makers); the build weighs 8.44 kg including about 1.5 kg of tires.

disclosure: The fitter says everything was bought with his own money except gifted wheels and bars, which he names.
summary: A bike fitter explains his own race-oriented G21 build: fit choices, component selection to save weight and the 8.44 kg result.
